_doc: Low horizontal slash on the RIGHT side, HALF sweep: starts from the user's physically posed windup (captured.start, real degrees, posed 2026-09-12: hand ~0.33 m forward, 3.5 cm up, pan 18 own-right, blade near level) then sweeps across like the normal low slash but stops around halfway (end.pan -1 instead of -20, end.z between the posed start height and the old 0.08 low line). Was: computed windup at (0.22, 0.09) pan 20 -> end (0.27, 0.08) pan -20 in 0.4 s. Delete captured.start to recompute the windup from start/end.

_help.end.x: hand distance forward at the end of the slash (m, keep <= 0.27)
_help.end.z: height of the low line (m above the base plane)
_help.end.pan: where the slash ends (deg; negative = own left). -1 = halfway across; the full slash ended at -20
_help.start.dx: windup hand offset from the end, forward (m; negative = pulled back) - ignored while captured.start is set
_help.start.dz: windup hand offset from the end, up (m) - ignored while captured.start is set
_help.start.pan: where the slash starts (deg; + = own right) - ignored while captured.start is set
_help.roll: wrist roll: -90 = jaw swings sideways on this side (keep -90)
_help.jaw_open: how wide the sword cocks before the sweep (0..100): 42 = as the user posed it
_help.t_windup: seconds: rest -> the posed windup on the right
_help.t_slash: seconds: the half sweep (0.25 keeps roughly the full slash's pan speed: 40 deg in 0.4 s)
_help.captured.start: the windup pose in REAL arm degrees [pan, lift, elbow, wrist, roll, jaw], posed by hand on the arm; overrides start.*
_help.captured.end: pose captured from arm B (real degrees). Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
_help.t_pause: seconds held at the strike-ready pose before the strike (a beat of stillness)
_help.retract: after the strike, back out this fraction of the way toward the strike-ready pose so the blade comes off the other arm before the next transition (0 = none)
